notes.title: Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree - Version 1.0.7 is now LIVE!🔴
notes.content:
✨ Hey everyone! ✨

We've listened to your feedback and we have a new update for Bahamut and The Waqwaq Tree, and the best part is, it's live now! You can read the full patch notes below 👇

Patch Notes For Version 1.0.7: 
Improved drawing shape recognition to make it easier for users to draw circles

Removed the timer from NPC dialogues

Adjusted the volume for some NPC sound effects

Adjusted the timer for certain gates to make it easier for users to pass through

Added visual feedback in case the user accidentally intersects the line while solving the Linking Dots puzzle

Added a checkpoint in Level 2.1 to prevent a soft lock situation

Adjusted the position of certain checkpoints to prevent the user from respawning too far away

Added a few scripted camera moments to guide the player

Fixed the French subtitle issue during the final cutscene

Minor visual tweaks and fixes

Minor Arabic localization text fixes

We hop you enjoy these updates. If you have any other issues, send us your feedback on our Discord.

Also, if you haven't yet, please review us on Steam!   



Happy gaming, and remember to always follow the light. 🐋🕯️
🐋 Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree - 0.3.6.alpha Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
Bugfixes:

Fixed VSync option being reversed (on was off, off was on).
Adjustments to layering to prevent the player for being rendered behind background/midground elements.
Scroll bar adjusted on first scrollable text.
Fixed double input issue on disclaimer dismissal fixed.

Other:

Subtitles in cutscenes typography changed for a more visible font.
Increased lighting on last area after Light Tree activation.
Corrected some typos on the Arabic version of the text.

notes.title: Play Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree in Steam Next Fest! | Demo Announcement
notes.content:
Hi everyone! ✨

We are excited to announce that we will be featured in the upcoming Steam Next Fest! 🌊 We can’t wait to see your reactions and hear your feedback as you dive into Ma'een with us.

Experience Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree for the first time in our Steam Next Fest Demo, available on June 10th - 17th!

During the Steam Next Fest, you can:

Play the Demo: Experience a sneak peek of the game and get a taste of the adventure that awaits.
Join Live streams: Participate in live streams to dive deep into the game’s lore, mechanics, and development process.
Join the Discord: Chat with the developers and community on our Discord channel for ongoing discussions and exclusive insights.

More details about the streams and demo coming soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506877/a200866cde33ea9e1424c1ef52126cac47b13e02.gif
About Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree
Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree is an immersive adventure game inspired by Arabian and Middle Eastern mythology. Get ready to submerge yourself in a captivating underwater realm, explore the cosmic sea of Ma'een, and unlock the secrets of an ancient mystery.
Key Features:

Explore the cosmic sea, Ma'een 🌊
Harness the power of the light ✨
Solve the ancient mystery 🔒

We hope you're excited for the demo as much as we are. See you at Steam Next Fest! 👋
 🐋 Stay tuned for more updates!
